The project will be evidence-led rather than advocacy-led: the rubric will separate observed impact from plausible worst-case impact, allow explicit “unknown” entries, and preserve disagreement instead of forcing a single severity score. All scenarios will be fictional and non-operational; no confidential incident information will be solicited.

I’m also preparing, but **not submitting**, the public comment and grant application. The docket publishes filer names, and the grant requires Morgan to be the accountable signatory, so neither is appropriate to fire off automatically today.
